description: Read-only. Answers 'what multiple does a business in industry X sell for?' for ONE industry. Returns median EV/EBITDA and EV/Revenue multiples with the middle 50% (25th-75th percentile) and deal count n, broken down by enterprise-value bracket (disclosed deals 2018-2026, n>=10 per cell) plus an all-deal-sizes figure (n>=5). Figures below those thresholds are withheld, never estimated. Passing an industry group id (e.g. 'home-services') returns one all-sizes median per sub-vertical. Use compare_industries to put several industries side by side and get_multiples_trend for year-by-year history. Population medians only: it does not value a specific business.

industry.description: Sub-vertical id from list_industries (e.g. 'hvac', 'dental-practice'), or a plain-English name ('HVAC', 'dentist', 'plumber', 'MSP'); plain names are mapped to the closest tracked category and the answer says which one was used. An industry group id such as 'healthcare' or 'home-services' is also accepted.

size_bracket.description: Optional enterprise-value (deal size) bracket: under_5m_ev = under $5M, 5m_25m_ev = $5M-$25M, 25m_100m_ev = $25M-$100M, 100m_500m_ev = $100M-$500M, over_500m_ev = $500M and up. Omit to get every published bracket.
